title: Leavenworth Private Day Trip from Seattle and Cascade Mountains
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape Seattle for a memorable private day trip to Leavenworth, one of Washington’s most charming mountain destinations. Travel comfortably through the scenic Cascade Mountains and enjoy beautiful views along the way.

Explore Leavenworth’s Bavarian-style streets, browse local shops, discover restaurants, take photos, and enjoy free time to experience the town at your own pace. With a private vehicle and professional local driver, you can enjoy a more relaxed and personalized experience without the stress of driving or joining a crowded bus tour.

Your driver can also share local recommendations and help you make the most of your visit. The route and stops may vary depending on weather, traffic, seasonal conditions, and available time.

Pickup is available from your confirmed Seattle-area hotel, residence, or eligible address. Provide your pickup address, passenger count, luggage details, and mobile number when booking.

Reserve your private Leavenworth day trip from Seattle today.
